message: You know that friend who thinks the sky is falling every time there's a storm? 🌧️ I get it, sometimes it feels a bit overwhelming! That's why I like to have a plan in place, especially when it comes to being on the road. I recently found a great resource that helps remind me of the essentials to keep in my car for those unexpected moments. It’s all about being prepared without the panic, and it gives me peace of mind. What’s your go-to tip for staying calm when things get a little wild?
